name: Jiggly Cash
review:
Jiggly Cash is a bouncy 6-reel slot with a bubbly mystery feature, avalanches and a bonus game.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 10,000x cap and a 96.46% RTP.

Avalanches give each spin a chance to chain wins, and the bubbly mystery feature can reveal a lot of matching symbols at once. Bright, rubbery and much spikier than it looks.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
